"""Read-only current Windows Video4 operation; original TEST assertions remain."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath, PureWindowsPath
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


PLAN_SHA = "1dee5aaece7c9acf774a9e2aa7cbc90d2600d1fd2148534048cf8cea28fced8b"
MAP_SHA = "86de6986af5f223a01280a76af5dc169417c6b26a7aeeb70038654838d53044d"
PYTHON_ROWS = 8532
PUBLICATION_PARENT = "33e67b27248e2975e5ac747099623f53dffd3b0f"
GOAL_ORIGIN = "33e67b27248e2975e5ac747099623f53dffd3b0f"
GOAL_MAP_SHA = "d707872012b23ee1a919c7173ff984ce297d920fc0b459f54599221120000485"
WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/console-pause-native-evidence.yml"
PACKET_ZIP = ".github/qualification/pr3023-video-r1/packet.zip"
SCOPE = "Full current permanent TEMP snapshot33e plus original picker TEST4931\u2192a30e; source is read-only throughout. Exactly original picker3 and existing controlled unsupported-capability negative. First picker must observe the actual unsupported Windows branch. No provider/generation/OS-paint, latency, full-Goal, general native retirement or Task completion."


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def write(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def digest(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in value)


def relative(root, name):
    assert isinstance(name, str) and "\\" not in name
    parts = PurePosixPath(name)
    assert name and not parts.is_absolute() and all(p not in ("", ".", "..") for p in parts.parts)
    target = root.joinpath(*parts.parts).resolve()
    assert target.is_relative_to(root.resolve()) and target != root.resolve()
    return target


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "gc.auto=0", *args], cwd=root).decode().strip()


def sources(root):
    # Same Root predicate as the approved owner, including untracked Python.
    names = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "gc.auto=0", "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"], cwd=root)
    return {name: sha(relative(root, name)) for name in sorted(set(names.decode().split("\0")) - {""})
            if name.endswith(".py") and relative(root, name).is_file()}


def non_python(root, binding):
    rows = binding["non_python_guards"]
    assert rows and len({r["logical_path"] for r in rows}) == len(rows)
    for row in rows:
        path = relative(root, row["logical_path"])
        assert not row["logical_path"].endswith(".py")
        assert path.is_file() and digest(row["sha256"]) and sha(path) == row["sha256"]
    for name in ("pytest.ini", "setup.cfg"):
        assert not relative(root, name).exists()


def bound(path, expected):
    assert digest(expected) and sha(path) == expected
    binding = read(path)
    assert sha(Path(__file__).resolve()) == binding["outer_sha256"]
    return binding


def identity(root, binding):
    assert binding["status"] == "ROOT_BOUND_AND_INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEWED"
    for name in ("packet_manifest_sha256", "packet_zip_sha256", "reader_test_review_sha256",
                 "operational_review_sha256", "video_asset_inventory_review_sha256", "source_snapshot_review_sha256"):
        assert digest(binding[name])
    assert binding["publication_parent"] == PUBLICATION_PARENT
    assert binding["goal_snapshot_origin_commit"] == GOAL_ORIGIN
    assert binding["goal_snapshot_source_map_sha256"] == GOAL_MAP_SHA
    assert binding["workflow_path"] == WORKFLOW and binding["packet_zip_path"] == PACKET_ZIP
    assert binding["python_source_map_sha256"] == MAP_SHA and binding["python_source_rows"] == PYTHON_ROWS
    assert binding["command_plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA
    assert git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"]
    assert git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^") == PUBLICATION_PARENT
    changed = git(root, "diff", "--name-only", "HEAD^", "HEAD").splitlines()
    assert changed == binding["changed_paths"] and changed == sorted(set(changed))
    assert changed == sorted([WORKFLOW, PACKET_ZIP,
                              ".github/qualification/pr3023-video-r1/binding.json",
                              ".github/qualification/pr3023-video-r1/outer.py.txt",
                              "Tests/UI/test_console_video_picker_cancel.py"])
    assert not git(root, "diff", "HEAD", "--name-only")
    non_python(root, binding)
    return {"head": os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"], "parent": PUBLICATION_PARENT,
            "goal_snapshot_origin_commit": GOAL_ORIGIN, "goal_snapshot_source_map_sha256": GOAL_MAP_SHA,
            "changed_paths": changed, "scope": SCOPE}


def packet_check(packet, binding):
    assert sha(packet / "manifest.json") == binding["packet_manifest_sha256"]
    rows = read(packet / "manifest.json")["assets"]
    count = binding["packet_asset_count"]
    assert type(count) is int and 0 < count < 200 and len(rows) == count
    assert len({r["path"] for r in rows}) == count
    expected = {r["path"] for r in rows} | {"manifest.json"}
    actual = {p.relative_to(packet).as_posix() for p in packet.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    assert actual == expected
    for row in rows:
        path = relative(packet, row["path"])
        assert not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size == row["bytes"] and sha(path) == row["sha256"]
    assert sha(packet / "published-source-map.json") == MAP_SHA
    assert sha(packet / "command-plan.json") == PLAN_SHA
    plan, selected = read(packet / "command-plan.json"), read(packet / "published-source-map.json")
    assert len(selected) == PYTHON_ROWS and all(name.endswith(".py") and digest(value) for name, value in selected.items())
    assert plan["source_mode"] == "permanent_temp_snapshot_read_only" and plan["python_source_rows"] == PYTHON_ROWS
    assert "stage" not in plan and "products_staged" not in plan
    assert [(c["group"], c["mode"]) for c in plan["commands"]] == [("video_four", "collection"), ("video_four", "test")]
    nodes = plan["commands"][0]["expected_nodeids"]
    assert len(nodes) == len(set(nodes)) == 4 and set(plan["xml_expected"]) == set(nodes)
    assert plan["commands"][1]["expected_nodeids"] == nodes
    assert plan["bounds"] == {"natural_pytest_seconds": 180, "direct_child_outer_seconds": 210,
                              "direct_terminate_wait_seconds": 30, "direct_kill_wait_seconds": 30}
    return plan, selected


def snapshot(root, packet, binding):
    checkout = identity(root, binding)
    plan, selected = packet_check(packet, binding)
    actual = sources(root)
    assert actual == selected and len(actual) == PYTHON_ROWS
    roles = read(packet / "expected-sources.json")["sources"]
    source_roles = [row for row in roles if "logical_path" in row]
    runtime_roles = [row for row in roles if "runtime_path" in row]
    assert len(roles) == 48 and len(source_roles) == 38 and len(runtime_roles) == 10
    assert {row["module"] for row in runtime_roles} == {
        "textual.app", "textual.dom", "textual.worker", "textual.screen", "textual.widgets._toast",
        "textual.pilot", "textual.message_pump", "textual.worker_manager", "pytest_asyncio.plugin", "asyncio.base_events"}
    for row in source_roles:
        assert "runtime_path" not in row
        assert selected[row["logical_path"]] == row["sha256"] == sha(relative(root, row["logical_path"]))
    for row in runtime_roles:
        assert "logical_path" not in row and PureWindowsPath(row["runtime_path"]).is_absolute()
        frozen = relative(packet, row["snapshot_path"])
        assert frozen.stat().st_size == row["bytes"] and sha(frozen) == row["sha256"]
    return plan, actual, checkout, roles


def artifacts(archive):
    rows = [{"path": p.relative_to(archive).as_posix(), "sha256": sha(p), "bytes": p.stat().st_size}
            for p in sorted(archive.rglob("*")) if p.is_file() and p != archive / "artifacts.json"]
    write(archive / "artifacts.json", {"files": rows, "count": len(rows),
          "scope": "All extant archive files including hidden fixture files; manifest excludes itself."})


def initialize(root, archive, binding_path, expected_binding):
    primary, owned_archive = None, False
    try:
        binding = bound(binding_path, expected_binding)
        archive.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
        owned_archive = True
        provenance = archive / "provenance"
        provenance.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(binding_path, provenance / "binding.json")
        shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__), archive / "outer.py")
        write(archive / "checkout.json", identity(root, binding))
        for row in binding["non_python_guards"]:
            target = relative(provenance / "source-anchors", row["logical_path"])
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copyfile(relative(root, row["logical_path"]), target)
        zipped = relative(root, PACKET_ZIP)
        assert sha(zipped) == binding["packet_zip_sha256"]
        shutil.copyfile(zipped, provenance / "packet.zip")
        packet = archive / "packet"
        packet.mkdir()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zipped) as stream:
            entries = stream.infolist()
            assert len(entries) == binding["packet_asset_count"] + 1 and len({e.filename for e in entries}) == len(entries)
            assert all(not e.is_dir() and (e.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000 != 0o120000 for e in entries)
            assert sum(e.file_size for e in entries) < 8_000_000
            for entry in entries:
                target = relative(packet, entry.filename)
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                with target.open("xb") as output:
                    body = stream.read(entry)
                    assert output.write(body) == len(body)
        _plan, initial, _checkout, roles = snapshot(root, packet, binding)
        write(archive / "sources-initial.json", initial)
        write(archive / "declared-source-roles.json", {"mode": "permanent_snapshot_sources", "sources": roles})
        write(archive / "initialized.json", {"ok": True, "binding_sha256": expected_binding,
              "packet_asset_rows": binding["packet_asset_count"], "physical_packet_files": binding["packet_asset_count"] + 1,
              "python_rows": PYTHON_ROWS, "source_map_sha256": MAP_SHA, "scope": SCOPE})
    except BaseException as failure:
        primary = failure
        if owned_archive:
            try:
                write(archive / "initialization-error.json", {"traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
            except BaseException as diagnostic:
                primary.add_note("initialization diagnostic write: " + repr(diagnostic))
    finally:
        if owned_archive:
            try:
                artifacts(archive)
            except BaseException as diagnostic:
                if primary is None:
                    primary = diagnostic
                else:
                    primary.add_note("initialization archive manifest: " + repr(diagnostic))
    if primary is not None:
        raise primary


def runtime(packet, archive):
    assert os.name == "nt" and sys.platform == "win32" and sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 10) and not sys.flags.optimize
    wanted = read(packet / "runtime-binding.json")
    assert importlib.metadata.version("pytest") == wanted["pytest"] == "8.4.2"
    assert importlib.metadata.version("textual") == wanted["textual"] == "8.2.8"
    assert importlib.metadata.version("pytest-asyncio") == wanted["pytest-asyncio"] == "1.2.0"
    rows = []
    for row in wanted["sources"]:
        module = importlib.import_module(row["module"])
        path, spec = Path(module.__file__).resolve(), module.__spec__
        loader = type(spec.loader).__module__ + "." + type(spec.loader).__qualname__
        assert PureWindowsPath(path) == PureWindowsPath(spec.origin) == PureWindowsPath(row["runtime_path"])
        assert loader == row["loader_type"] and sha(path) == row["sha256"] and path.stat().st_size == row["bytes"]
        rows.append(dict(row, actual_path=str(path), spec_origin=spec.origin, actual_loader=loader))
    assert len(rows) == 3
    assert not any(name == "tldw_chatbook" or name.startswith("tldw_chatbook.") for name in sys.modules)
    write(archive / "runtime-actual.json", {"python": sys.version, "executable": sys.executable,
          "platform": platform.platform(), "pytest": wanted["pytest"], "textual": wanted["textual"],
          "pytest-asyncio": wanted["pytest-asyncio"], "sources": rows,
          "scope": "Actual file/path/spec/version guard only; real child gates bind callable/Video/fixture relationships."})


def cases(path, expected, plan):
    document = ET.parse(path)
    result = list(document.iter("testcase"))
    assert [(c.get("classname"), c.get("name")) for c in result] == [
        (plan["xml_expected"][n]["classname"], plan["xml_expected"][n]["name"]) for n in expected]
    suites = list(document.iter("testsuite"))
    assert len(suites) == 1 and int(suites[0].get("tests")) == len(result) == 4
    for attribute, tag in (("failures", "failure"), ("errors", "error"), ("skipped", "skipped")):
        assert int(suites[0].get(attribute)) == sum(len(c.findall(tag)) for c in result)
    return result


def assess(command, directory, receipt, plan):
    nodes = command["expected_nodeids"]
    assert len(nodes) == 4
    if command["mode"] == "collection":
        found = [line.strip() for line in (directory / "stdout.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                 if line.strip().startswith("Tests/") and "::" in line]
        ok = found == nodes and receipt["returncode"] == 0
        return {"ok": ok, "classification": "EXACT_FOUR_COLLECTION" if ok else "NEGATIVE_COLLECTION",
                "nodeids": found, "returncode": receipt["returncode"]}
    result = cases(directory / "pytest.xml", nodes, plan)
    outcomes = [{"nodeid": node, "failure": len(case.findall("failure")), "error": len(case.findall("error")),
                 "skipped": len(case.findall("skipped"))} for node, case in zip(nodes, result)]
    gate_errors, gates = [], []
    expected = {directory / "gates" / hashlib.sha256(node.encode()).hexdigest()[:20] / "gate.json" for node in nodes}
    if set((directory / "gates").rglob("gate.json")) != expected:
        gate_errors.append("gate receipt set differs from exact four")
    for node in nodes:
        path = directory / "gates" / hashlib.sha256(node.encode()).hexdigest()[:20] / "gate.json"
        try:
            gate = read(path)
            assert gate["nodeid"] == node
            for key in ("gate_complete", "owned_tool_retired", "profile_trace_unchanged", "call_passed"):
                assert gate[key] is True, key
            assert gate["observer_errors"] == []
            if node == nodes[0]:
                assert gate["actual_unsupported_branch"] is True
            gates.append({"nodeid": node, "path": path.relative_to(directory).as_posix(), "sha256": sha(path)})
        except BaseException:
            gate_errors.append(node + ": " + traceback.format_exc())
    ok = receipt["returncode"] == 0 and all(not any(row[k] for k in ("failure", "error", "skipped")) for row in outcomes) and not gate_errors
    return {"ok": ok, "classification": "FOUR_PASS_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW" if ok else "NEGATIVE_BODY_OR_GATE",
            "returncode": receipt["returncode"], "parent_cases": 4, "private_profile_children": 0,
            "case_outcomes": outcomes, "gate_receipts": gates, "gate_errors": gate_errors,
            "scope": "Literal XML/receipt classification only; raw Video branch/fixture facts and exact release relationships require independent actual audit."}


def child(command, root, packet, archive, plan, direct_memory):
    fields = {"python": sys.executable, "checkout_root": str(root), "packet_root": str(packet),
              "archive": str(archive), "pathsep": os.pathsep}
    directory = Path(command["archive"].format(**fields)).resolve()
    assert directory.is_relative_to(archive)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    (directory / "gates").mkdir()
    argv = [part.format(**fields) for part in command["argv"]]
    environment = dict(os.environ)
    for name in plan["environment_remove"]:
        environment.pop(name, None)
    for source in (plan["environment"], command["environment"]):
        environment.update({key: value.format(**fields) for key, value in source.items()})
    receipt = {"argv": argv, "cwd": str(root), "parent_pid": os.getpid(), "started": False,
               "environment_overrides": {key: environment[key] for key in plan["environment"]}, "waited": False}
    # Complete intent before Popen, then retain the actual object before any
    # receipt write. Serialized PIDs are never cleanup authority.
    write(directory / "start-intent.json", {key: receipt[key] for key in ("argv", "cwd", "parent_pid")})
    process, primary = None, None
    try:
        with (directory / "stdout.log").open("wb") as out, (directory / "stderr.log").open("wb") as err:
            direct_index = len(direct_memory)
            direct_memory.append((None, receipt))
            process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=root, env=environment, stdout=out, stderr=err)
            direct_memory[direct_index] = (process, receipt)
            receipt.update(started=True, pid=process.pid)
            write(directory / "process.json", receipt)
            receipt["returncode"] = process.wait(timeout=210)
            receipt["waited"] = True
            receipt["poll"] = process.poll()
    except BaseException as failure:
        primary = failure
    finally:
        if process is not None:
            try:
                if not receipt["waited"]:
                    if process.poll() is None:
                        try:
                            process.terminate()
                            receipt["cleanup_terminated"] = True
                        except BaseException:
                            receipt["terminate_error"] = traceback.format_exc()
                    try:
                        receipt["cleanup_returncode"] = process.wait(timeout=30)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        process.kill()
                        receipt["cleanup_killed"] = True
                        receipt["cleanup_returncode"] = process.wait(timeout=30)
                    receipt["waited"] = True
                    receipt["waited_in_cleanup"] = True
            except BaseException as cleanup:
                if primary is None:
                    primary = cleanup
                else:
                    primary.add_note("direct-child cleanup: " + repr(cleanup))
            try:
                receipt["final_poll"] = process.poll()
            except BaseException as cleanup:
                if primary is None:
                    primary = cleanup
                else:
                    primary.add_note("direct-child final poll: " + repr(cleanup))
            receipt["direct_child_handle_scope"] = "Actual Popen object/pid/wait/poll on Windows. Four plain bodies declare no memo child; no POSIX ECHILD, arbitrary descendant or hard-cancellation claim."
        try:
            write(directory / "process.json", receipt)
        except BaseException as diagnostic:
            if primary is None:
                primary = diagnostic
            else:
                primary.add_note("direct-child receipt write: " + repr(diagnostic))
    if primary is not None:
        raise primary
    assert receipt["started"] and receipt["waited"] and receipt["poll"] == receipt["returncode"] == receipt["final_poll"]
    result = assess(command, directory, receipt, plan)
    write(directory / "assessment.json", result)
    return result


def audit(root, archive, binding=None, direct_memory=None):
    # Read-only even on a failed/partial initialization or missing evidence.
    errors, custody_errors, receipt_errors = [], [], []
    attempt, actual, checkout = None, None, None
    try:
        attempt = archive / ("audit-attempt-" + str(len(list(archive.glob("audit-attempt-*")))))
        attempt.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    except BaseException:
        errors.append("audit directory: " + traceback.format_exc())
    try:
        actual = sources(root)
    except BaseException:
        errors.append("observed published source map: " + traceback.format_exc())
    try:
        if binding is None:
            initialized = read(archive / "initialized.json")
            binding = bound(archive / "provenance/binding.json", initialized["binding_sha256"])
        initialized = read(archive / "initialized.json")
        assert initialized["ok"] is True
        assert sha(archive / "provenance/binding.json") == initialized["binding_sha256"]
        assert read(archive / "provenance/binding.json") == binding
        _plan, guarded, checkout, _roles = snapshot(root, archive / "packet", binding)
        assert actual == guarded
    except BaseException:
        errors.append("published snapshot/identity/evidence guard: " + traceback.format_exc())
    if direct_memory is not None:
        for process, receipt in direct_memory:
            try:
                code = receipt.get("cleanup_returncode") if receipt.get("waited_in_cleanup") else receipt.get("returncode")
                assert (process is not None and receipt.get("started") and receipt.get("waited")
                        and process.pid == receipt.get("pid") and code is not None
                        and process.poll() == code == receipt.get("final_poll"))
            except BaseException:
                custody_errors.append("unsettled actual in-memory direct child: " + traceback.format_exc())
    # Evidence is checked even when memory proves retirement. In that case a
    # missing receipt is diagnostic incompleteness, not a claim of a live child.
    intents = {p.parent: p for p in archive.rglob("start-intent.json")}
    receipts = {p.parent: p for p in archive.rglob("process.json")}
    paired_memory = set()
    for directory in sorted(set(intents) | set(receipts)):
        try:
            assert directory in {archive / "video_four/collection", archive / "video_four/test"}
            intent, receipt = read(intents[directory]), read(receipts[directory])
            assert all(intent[key] == receipt[key] for key in ("argv", "cwd", "parent_pid"))
            code = receipt.get("cleanup_returncode") if receipt.get("waited_in_cleanup") else receipt.get("returncode")
            assert receipt.get("started") and receipt.get("waited") and code is not None and receipt.get("final_poll") == code
            if direct_memory is not None:
                matches = [index for index, (process, saved) in enumerate(direct_memory)
                           if process is not None and process.pid == receipt.get("pid") and saved == receipt]
                assert len(matches) == 1 and matches[0] not in paired_memory
                paired_memory.add(matches[0])
        except BaseException:
            receipt_errors.append("missing/unsettled direct-child intent/receipt: " + str(directory.relative_to(archive)))
    if direct_memory is not None:
        for index, (process, receipt) in enumerate(direct_memory):
            if process is not None and receipt.get("started") and index not in paired_memory:
                receipt_errors.append("started actual direct child lacks exactly one validated intent/receipt pair: memory index " + str(index))
    errors.extend(custody_errors)
    errors.extend(receipt_errors)
    try:
        if actual is not None and attempt is not None:
            write(attempt / "sources-observed.json", actual)
    except BaseException:
        errors.append("audit map write: " + traceback.format_exc())
    result = {"ok": not errors, "errors": errors, "custody_errors": custody_errors, "receipt_errors": receipt_errors,
              "custody_mode": "actual_retained_Popen_objects" if direct_memory is not None else "persisted_evidence_only_no_process_adoption",
              "direct_child_intents": len(intents), "direct_child_receipts": len(receipts),
              "retained_direct_objects": len(direct_memory) if direct_memory is not None else None,
              "validated_memory_pairs": len(paired_memory) if direct_memory is not None else None,
              "published_python_rows": len(actual) if actual is not None else None, "checkout": checkout,
              "scope": SCOPE + " No source rollback/removal or serialized-PID cleanup occurs. Missing serialized custody remains unproven."}
    for target in ([attempt / "audit.json"] if attempt is not None else []) + [archive / "final-audit.json"]:
        try:
            write(target, result)
        except BaseException:
            errors.append("audit receipt write: " + traceback.format_exc())
            result["ok"] = False
    return result


def run(root, archive):
    packet, binding = archive / "packet", None
    results, errors, direct_memory = [], [], []
    primary, final = None, None
    try:
        write(archive / "outer-process.json", {"pid": os.getpid(), "parent_pid": os.getppid(), "argv": sys.argv,
              "executable": sys.executable, "scope": "Self-reported foreground outer; two actual direct-child waits/polls are separate."})
        initialized = read(archive / "initialized.json")
        assert initialized["ok"] is True
        assert initialized["binding_sha256"] == os.environ["VIDEO_FOUR_BINDING_SHA256"]
        binding = bound(archive / "provenance/binding.json", initialized["binding_sha256"])
        plan, before, _checkout, _roles = snapshot(root, packet, binding)
        write(archive / "sources-before.json", before)
        assert not os.environ.get("TLDW_TEST_PRIVATE_PROFILE_NODE") and os.environ.get("TLDW_REQUIRE_ELEVATED_CUSTODY") != "1"
        runtime(packet, archive)
        for command in plan["commands"]:
            snapshot(root, packet, binding)
            try:
                result = child(command, root, packet, archive, plan, direct_memory)
                results.append(dict(group=command["group"], mode=command["mode"], **result))
                if not result["ok"]:
                    raise RuntimeError("literal Windows Video4 " + command["mode"] + " result is negative; inspect raw archive")
            finally:
                child_failure = sys.exc_info()[1]
                try:
                    after = sources(root)
                    write(archive / ("sources-after-" + command["mode"] + ".json"), after)
                    _plan, guarded, _checkout, _roles = snapshot(root, packet, binding)
                    assert after == guarded
                except BaseException as guard_failure:
                    if child_failure is None:
                        raise
                    child_failure.add_note("post-child source/evidence guard: " + repr(guard_failure))
    except BaseException as failure:
        primary = failure
        errors.append(traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        try:
            final = audit(root, archive, binding, direct_memory)
            if not final["ok"]:
                raise RuntimeError("read-only final audit incomplete or refused")
        except BaseException as failure:
            if final is None:
                final = {"ok": False, "errors": [traceback.format_exc()]}
            if primary is None:
                primary = failure
                errors.append(traceback.format_exc())
            else:
                primary.add_note("read-only final audit: " + repr(failure))
        complete = primary is None and final["ok"] and len(results) == 2 and all(row["ok"] for row in results)
        result = {"ordered_results": results, "errors": errors, "final_audit": final,
                  "status": "FOUR_PASS_PENDING_ARCHIVE_AND_INDEPENDENT_ACTUAL_REVIEW" if complete else "INCOMPLETE_OR_NEGATIVE_RESULT",
                  "scope": SCOPE}
        for action in (lambda: write(archive / "result.json", result), lambda: artifacts(archive)):
            try:
                action()
            except BaseException as diagnostic:
                if primary is None:
                    primary = diagnostic
                else:
                    primary.add_note("final result/archive evidence: " + repr(diagnostic))
    if primary is not None:
        raise primary
    return 0 if complete else 1


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("initialize", "run", "audit"))
    parser.add_argument("--checkout", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--archive", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--binding", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--binding-sha256")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, archive = args.checkout.resolve(), args.archive.resolve()
    assert os.name == "nt" and sys.platform == "win32" and sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 10) and not sys.flags.optimize
    assert archive.is_relative_to((Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"]) / ".config").resolve()) and not archive.is_relative_to(root)
    if args.mode == "initialize":
        assert args.binding is not None
        initialize(root, archive, args.binding.resolve(), args.binding_sha256)
        return 0
    if args.mode == "run":
        return run(root, archive)
    primary = None
    try:
        binding = bound(args.binding.resolve(), args.binding_sha256) if args.binding is not None else None
        final = audit(root, archive, binding)
        return 0 if final["ok"] else 1
    except BaseException as failure:
        primary = failure
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            artifacts(archive)
        except BaseException as diagnostic:
            if primary is None:
                raise
            primary.add_note("shell audit archive manifest: " + repr(diagnostic))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
